hliberty.summary: Engaged in the development, maintenance, and evolution of production web systems, with a strong focus on backend, infrastructure, and code quality.

details.item1: Responsible for CI/CD pipelines, version control, and code reviews.
details.item2: Maintenance and monitoring of Linux servers (Docker, Nginx).
details.item3: Development of internal dashboards and system integrations.
details.item4: Active participation in technical decisions and mentoring junior developers.
details.item5: Main stack: Laravel, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and Docker.

ufpel.summary: Development of a testable web prototype for creating and analyzing geospatial maps, enabling users to submit responses through an interactive grid and visualize the results directly on the map.

details.item1: Implementation of interactive maps and geospatial grids for collecting user responses.
details.item2: Development of features for map creation and generation, as well as analysis of collected data.
details.item3: Implementation of user result overlays on the map to facilitate spatial visualization and analysis.
details.item4: Main stack: React, Leaflet, Laravel, and MySQL.

furg.summary: Development of a mobile game focused on education and awareness of participatory water resource management, using an interactive experience to introduce concepts of decision-making and resource management.

details.item1: Development of a mobile application using React Native.
details.item2: Implementation of the game's interactive experience, focused on simulating participatory water resource management.
details.item3: Development of interfaces and game mechanics centered around player decision-making.
details.item4: Collaboration with the project team to transform educational requirements into an interactive gaming experience.
